summary: S1 (eps 1-51) adapts manga ch1-26 (vols 1-6) with heavy expansion; the last new chapter is 26 at eps 43-44, and eps 45-63 adapt nothing new (WDTALO confirms: after S1 continue at ch27). Doki (52-102) adapts only ch27-41: ch27-32 across eps 64-81, then a long anime-original Lulu ?-egg stretch (eps 82-96, AFL-canon but no chapter counterparts), then eps 97-102 compress ch32-41 for the Easter-tower climax. Party (103-127) is anime-original; the finale ep127 borrows only the Ikuto-farewell scene from ch42 (contemporary manga-reader blog confirms the scene is manga-sourced and the Tadase cheek-kiss is not), so the existing MU anchor ep127->41 is kept as the series-progress instrument with continue point 42. Main manga = 48 chapters (ch48 final) + special ch18.5 (adapted out of order by ep25) + 4 Encore chapters in vol 12; fandom chapter numbering matches our 48-chapter space. Major caveat: our DB episode numbering for 74-95 matches animefillerlist but NOT broadcast order (Wikipedia/fandom) - our rows lack a #73 and are missing broadcast ep95 'Rima, Yaya, and the Pearls that Bind Them' entirely; all anchors were title-matched into OUR numbering.

structure.notes: 3 seasons, cumulative 1-127. S1 (1-51) = ch1-26 (vols 1-6); Doki (52-102) = ch27-41 (vols 7-10) with a large anime-original Lulu arc; Party (103-127) anime-original except ch42 fragments in ep127. Main manga = 48 numbered chapters (ch48 = final, per fandom ch48 page and contemporaneous fan blogs), + special ch18.5 (vol 4) + 4 Encore chapters in vol 12 (Wikipedia volumes list); fandom chapter numbering = our 48-chapter space. Volume boundaries per fandom chapter pages: v1:1-5, v2:6-10, v3:11-14, v4:15-18(+18.5), v5:19-22, v6:23-26, v7:27-30, v8:31-34, v9:35-39, v10:40-44, v11:45-48, v12:Encore. NUMBERING: our DB rows 74-95 match animefillerlist numbering but NOT broadcast numbering (Wikipedia + fandom agree on broadcast): our DB has no ep73 row, is missing broadcast ep95 'Rima, Yaya, and the Pearls that Bind Them' (2009-08-08) entirely, and holds most of broadcast 73-94 shifted +1 with internal swaps (our 75/76 = broadcast 75/74; our 83/84 = broadcast 83/82; our 90/91 = broadcast 90/89). All anchors were converted into OUR numbering by exact title match against the context rows. Our rows 107/108 also swap broadcast air-date order (both filler, harmless).
